errors.text_span: a shared, rotated y-axis label reads "Inference Time (minute)."
errors.evidence: This is misleading. While the text "Inference Time (minute)" is physically placed along the y-axis, it is the label for the quantity measured along the horizontal x-axis (the length of the bars). The description incorrectly identifies it as the 'y-axis label' without clarifying that it describes the x-axis values.
In the 'QwQ-32B-Preview' chart, the bar for DPO extends to approximately 5.8 or 5.9 minutes, just slightly shorter than the SFT bar. The stated value of 5.6 minutes is a significant underestimate.
In the 'QwQ-32B-Preview' chart, the bar for 'Fast-Solving Prompt' clearly extends beyond the 5-minute mark to approximately 5.2 minutes. Stating the value is 5.0 minutes is incorrect.
